description: This file contains C code for DHCP utility functions including socket creation, sending, receiving DHCP messages, and ARP record insertion. It also includes diagnostic data dump functions for debugging purposes.

methods.name: void dhcp_send(int s,const unsigned char * msg,unsigned int size,struct sockaddr_in dest_addr)
methods.description: Sends a DHCP message via a socket to a specified destination address.

methods.name: void insert_arp_record(int s,const char * device_name,struct sockaddr_in ip_addr,ui8 htype,ui8 hlen,ui8 * chaddr)
methods.description: Inserts an ARP record for a specified IP address and hardware address.

methods.name: int dhcp_create_socket(int port,const char * device_name)
methods.description: Creates and binds a DHCP socket on a specified port and device.

methods.name: int dhcp_recvfrom_to(int s,void * buf,size_t len,int flags,struct sockaddr_in * from,struct in_addr * to)
methods.description: Receives a DHCP packet from a socket, providing the source address and target IP address.

methods.name: void dump_data(const unsigned char * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Outputs binary data in a formatted hexadecimal and ASCII representation.

methods.name: void dump_data_short(const unsigned char * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Outputs binary data in a short-form hexadecimal and ASCII.

methods.name: void dump_mac_addr(const void * param)
methods.description: Dumps a MAC address in human-readable format.

methods.name: void dump_ip_addr(const void * param)
methods.description: Dumps an IP address in dotted-decimal notation.

methods.name: void dump_ip_list(const unsigned char * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Dumps a list of IP addresses.

methods.name: void dump_dhcp_option(const struct dhcp_option * p_option)
methods.description: Dumps a specific DHCP option's content.

methods.name: void dump_dhcp_option_list(const struct dhcp_option * option_list)
methods.description: Dumps a list of DHCP options.

methods.name: void dump_dhcp_msg(const struct dhcp_msg * msg,const struct dhcp_option_info * opts)
methods.description: Dumps a DHCP message including headers and options.

ctags.name: dhcp_recvfrom_to
ctags.pattern: /^int dhcp_recvfrom_to(int s, void *buf, size_t len, int flags,$/
ctags.signature: (int s,void * buf,size_t len,int flags,struct sockaddr_in * from,struct in_addr * to)

ctags.name: dhcp_send
ctags.pattern: /^void dhcp_send(int s, const unsigned char *msg, unsigned int size, struct sockaddr_in dest_addr)$/
ctags.signature: (int s,const unsigned char * msg,unsigned int size,struct sockaddr_in dest_addr)

ctags.name: dump_dhcp_msg
ctags.pattern: /^void dump_dhcp_msg(const struct dhcp_msg *msg, const struct dhcp_option_info *opts)$/
ctags.signature: (const struct dhcp_msg * msg,const struct dhcp_option_info * opts)

ctags.name: insert_arp_record
ctags.signature: (int s,const char * device_name,struct sockaddr_in ip_addr,ui8 htype,ui8 hlen,ui8 * chaddr)
